_comment: The declared crossings of the SDK/app boundary, enforced by the juggler/sdk-boundary ESLint rule (tooling/eslint.config.js). "sdk": Apache-2.0 web/sdk/** modules that import the AGPL web/js/** tree (host bindings); LICENSING.md's boundary audit is rendered from them by TestLicensingBoundaryAudit (web/sdk_boundary_test.go, UPDATE=1 rewrites it). "extensions": bundled extension modules that import web/js/** or web/sdk/lib/** by relative path instead of through a juggler/* specifier. Each entry says why; an entry whose import is gone fails the lint.

web/sdk/file-source.js.why: addresses the host's file-content, tree and asset endpoints under its base path

web/sdk/lib/sandbox-runner.js.why: addresses the host's sandbox page under its base path

web/sdk/model.js.why: the compaction lifecycle is the host's

web/sdk/pinboard.js.why: pins go to the host's board; pin descriptors come from the loaded extensions

web/sdk/strategy-type.js.why: a strategy submits its turn through the host's orchestrator

web/sdk/ui.js.why: the host's own UI components and formatters, so an extension's UI matches the app's

web/sdk/ui-worker.js.why: the DOM-free subset of the ui.js bindings, for the engine worker

web/extensions/juggler-core/cards/git-st.why: shows the host's git-status cache, shared with the app's own git UI

web/extensions/juggler-core/cards/usage-.why: shows the host's provider, model and usage caches

web/extensions/juggler-core/context-item.why: writes to the host's user-command store
reads the host's skill store and opens its settings preview
assembles the host's own system prompt: preset registry, extension contributions, tool inventory, MCP state and the transcript of the last turn sent

web/extensions/juggler-core/strategies/a.why: reads the host's file-editing permission toggle

web/extensions/juggler-core/viewers/pdf-.why: loads the vendored PDF.js (Apache-2.0, web/js/vendor/README.md) on demand; not app code

web/extensions/juggler-core/workspaces/g.why: asks the host's git-status endpoint; the SDK has no git API

web/extensions/juggler-mcp/context-items.why: listens for the host's plugin-changed push; the SDK has no server-event subscription
